title: SFFV in refinement list: when there is no result, the show more doesn't work afterwards
body:
A user on our [community forum](https://discourse.algolia.com/t/show-more-option-not-working-after-facet-value-search-in-instansearch-js/3204) found a bug when using "search for facet values" with "show more".

He did a video in which he shows [how to reproduce the bug](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q5gXj-hT2ws&feature=player_embedded).

Steps to reproduce the issue:
 - have a [refinement list with search for facet values and show more activated](https://jsfiddle.net/xe6drzyh/1/)
 - search until no results
 - remove the search
 - show more is not usable anymore
